text: Implemented chunk-safe voxelwise estimated-AR GLS. Gls.prepare now records full-selection voxel ids and one whitening plan per selected voxel; chunk execution selects prepared plans by voxel id, diagnostics carry voxelwise coefficients and mark normalized covariance non-shared, and dense contrast inference rejects voxelwise AR until per-voxel covariance bundles exist. Added direct and future-chunked tests for voxelwise AR. Evidence: sbt fitJVM/test passed 111; sbt fitJS/test passed 108; scoped diff whitespace checks clean. Remaining: robust-triggered phi re-estimation and fuller result-bundle support for per-voxel covariance inference.
